subject: Reworking demo cadence — security + infra + procurement are joining
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@veramed.io>, Tania Gomez <tania@veramed.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo — proposing Wed 30th 10am PT (initial)

Hi Samir / Tania —

Thanks again for the time last week. We scoped a short walkthrough of the Redwood inference platform for next Wednesday (30th) at 10:00 AM PT. Intended agenda (30m):
- 10m: Quick product overview
- 15m: live demo tailored to VeraHealth infra needs
- 5m: next steps / procurement touchpoints

Marissa and Vivek will present the demo. Can you confirm both Samir and procurement (if they want to join) are available? I dropped a draft agenda attached.

If the proposed slot doesn't work, we can offer two alternate windows.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v3.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir@veramed.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tania Gomez <tania@veramed.io>, procurement@veramed.io
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposing Wed 30th 10am PT (initial)

Jordan —

Appreciate the agenda. Quick heads-up: procurement (procurement@veramed.io) and our platform security lead will want to attend this run-through — our security lead is out traveling next week (return Thu 1st), and procurement has a standing review at 10am on the 30th. Can we look at either:
- Tue 29th 11:00 AM PT OR
- Thu 1st 9:00 AM PT

If neither works, we may need a split session: technical deep-dive (infra + platform) with your engineers and a separate commercial/procurement session. Also copying procurement in case they want to propose a time.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, VeraHealth
samir@veramed.io
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@veramed.io>
Cc: Tania Gomez <tania@veramed.io>, procurement@veramed.io, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 12:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposing Wed 30th 10am PT (follow-up with options)

Thanks Samir — totally understand. Two quick asks and a plan:
1) Would VeraHealth prefer a single longer session (60–75m) to include security + procurement + infra, or a split 45m technical deep-dive + 30m procurement/pricing call?
2) Proposed alternate windows we can offer immediately:
   - Option A: Tue 29 Jun, 11:00–12:15 PT (single 75m session)
   - Option B: Thu 1 Jul, 09:00–10:15 PT (single 75m session)
   - Option C: Split: Tue 29 Jun 11:00–11:45 PT (technical) + Thu 1 Jul 09:00–09:30 PT (procurement)

Marissa — can you confirm you and Vivek can cover the technical deep-dive and have someone from infra join if needed?

Kimberly — can you and I handle procurement questions on the short follow-up if VeraHealth wants the split? I attached a short infra questionnaire (MVP-infra-questions.docx) that may speed the technical discussion.

Would appreciate a quick preference so we can lock a meeting invite.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Technical deep-dive: Tue 29 Jun, 11:00–11:45 AM PT (Marissa, Vivek + VeraHealth platform/security)

Please send two calendar invites (one for each slot) and include the attached agenda for the technical session. Procurement requested a short pre-read, so I attached their procurement email and priority questions.

See you then — looking forward.
